api_list.name: get geo map for regions
api_list.description: The "Trending Keywords by Geo Regions" API allows developers to access a list of 50 geographic regions and their corresponding trending keywords. With this API, developers can retrieve valuable insights into the most popular and trending search terms for specific locations.
api_list.code:
import requests

url = "https://trends-keywords-in-different-regions.p.rapidapi.com/geomap"

headers = {
            "X-RapidAPI-Key": "SIGN-UP-FOR-KEY",
            "X-RapidAPI-Host": "trends-keywords-in-different-regions.p.rapidapi.com"
